strategy.thesis: Peter Thiel-founded generalist VC/growth firm (~$17B AUM) with a sustained, decade-plus health/biotech practice large enough that Wikipedia tracks it as a distinct 'Biotech and healthcare' portfolio bucket, not a couple of opportunistic bets: led Stemcentrx's Series B in oncology therapeutics (an antibody-drug-conjugate developer; the round reportedly returned $1.4B off a $300M investment), led Neuralink's $280M Series D and joined its $650M Series E (neurotech/BCI), backed Ultima Genomics' $600M round (DNA sequencing), led Oscar Health's $30M Series A (health insurance, later IPO'd) and Zocdoc's Series B (telemedicine, later joined its Series D), joined GoodRx's 2011 seed round (drug-price transparency, later IPO'd at ~$12.7B) and Hims & Hers' $100M 2019 round (D2C telehealth), gave early backing to Datavant (healthcare-data interoperability, spun out of Roivant Sciences) and Emerald Cloud Lab (cloud-lab automation, ~$13.5M cumulative Founders Fund backing by 2014), and currently holds active stakes in Cedar (healthcare billing) and Sword Health (digital MSK care). Partner Delian Asparouhov keeps an active bio-adjacent focus, co-founding and serving as President of Varda Space Industries, which manufactures pharmaceuticals in microgravity.
